description: Source code for a slash command provider handling the 'msg' command in Mattermost, enabling users to send direct messages via slash command.

classes.name: msgProvider
classes.description: Implements the command provider for the 'msg' slash command.

methods.name: GetTrigger
methods.description: Returns the trigger word for the command, which is 'msg'.

methods.name: GetCommand
methods.description: Returns the command configuration including trigger, description, and display name.

methods.name: DoCommand
methods.description: Executes the 'msg' command, handling message parsing, user and channel lookup, permission checks, and message posting.
